Taiwanese adolescents are using the Internet as a means for peer relationship enhancement and Internet dependent users are more sensation seeking and disinhibited than Internet non-dependent users.
Internet dependence of Taiwanese adolescents is related to disinhibition, but not to life experience seeking and thrill and adventure-seeking.
sensation seeking, particularly disinhibition, is a psychological factor that may lead to excessive Internet use among adolescents.

Internet dependents have a higher level of disinhibition than non-dependents and the former group is more likely to be influenced by negative aspects of the Internet.
sensation seeking and disinhibited personality traits may predispose some adolescents to excessive use of the Internet.
